description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for specifying search filter parameters for project reports in the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It includes properties for project ID and timesheet inclusion options, extending a date range filter class.

classes.name: ProjectReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class used for filtering project reports based on project ID, timesheet status, and date ranges.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter with default sort field 'projectActivity.name'.

methods.name: getProjectId
methods.description: Returns the project ID filter parameter.

methods.name: setProjectId
methods.description: Sets the project ID filter parameter.

methods.name: getIncludeApproveTimesheet
methods.description: Returns the timesheet inclusion filter value.

methods.name: setIncludeApproveTimesheet
methods.description: Sets the timesheet inclusion filter value.
